response.overview: In every human heart there is a place that is forever empty, and this pearl alone can fill to overflow this inner hollowness of man. All gifts that you are searching for are hidden in this pearl. Eternity comes first. The purpose in life and the reason to be. The freedom you long for and the forgiveness you seek. A love like no other. A presence that will never leave you and a spring of joy that will heal your soul. The chance to live once more. God’s might and goodness are also hidden in this pearl. Yet the greatest miracle of all is that all the while you are looking for the pearl, the pearl is calling upon you. The pearl has a name and those who know its name have found it. That name is Jesus Christ, our Lord. This film is about how to discover The Pearl of Great Price.
response.tagline: Who told you there's no purpose in your life, when I, Myself, am all - The Meaning, the Freedom, the Purpose, and the Life?
response.title: The Pearl Of Great Price
